ModMetaData.name: Mechs Never Die
ModMetaData.author: Snat
ModMetaData.description: Prevents non-hostile mechanoids from dying. When lethal damage or a direct kill effect would destroy a non-hostile mech, it is downed instead so the vanilla Biotech repair systems can restore its injuries and missing parts. Hostile mechs still die normally, and so do mechs on a non-rechargeable power cell such as war urchins once that cell runs dry.
